acceptance: The owner's decision on pause versus replay versus close is recorded.
The owner's decision on refusing default runs is recorded.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
#4331 is open and unarmed. Two things need the owner before repair: (1) the owner chose 'pause and retry' on 2026-11-17 but kill-and-replay, off by default, was built; (2) default DuckDB and Spark runs now refuse to start when the heavy-run budget minus the allowance is under 1 GiB (DuckDB below 4.5 GiB, Spark below 5.5 GiB; on an 8 GiB host every default DuckDB run under a heavy-run fails), and the deferral item requires owner approval of reduced supported capacity.

## Change
Record the owner's answers: repair as kill-and-replay, repair and build the true pause, or close the pull request; and whether a default run may ever be refused or must keep the earlier behaviour (DuckDB 4GB, Spark at least 1g).

## Decision gates
Blocked until the owner answers both.

## Verification rubric
Pass: both answers are recorded here verbatim.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
